name: Bloatrot Carrier
summary: A gas-swollen corpse that bursts into a cloud of rot when it falls.
description: Left in a flooded cellar or a sealed barrow, a body can swell until its skin is a drum. Grave-robbers hold their breath and use long poles, and still lose a crew a season.

understood: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: When the carrier dies, it explodes in a 10-foot Emanation. Each creature in that area makes a {dc:con} Constitution saving throw, taking {dmg:2d6:poison} on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Belch-Slam
actions.onHit: The target has the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition until the end of its next turn.
